description: Order an animated pixel sprite effect, for example a fireball or a healing light, from a preset or the user's own description, in parts that play one after another: 10 Gold for the first part and 8 for each more part. It can be drawn in an element's colours, or in the colours of one of the user's character sprite sets (reference_set_id). First call chargen_quote_sprite_effect, confirm the price with the user, then supply its quote_token with identical inputs. Returns request_id; poll chargen_get_job for each part's animated GIF. A part that fails is refunded. An identical call within about 10 minutes returns the earlier request instead of charging again; pass a new idempotency_key when the user wants another take with the same settings.

custom_parts.description: Parts in the user's own words.

plays.description: LOOP (the default) repeats, ONCE plays one time, HOLD plays and stops on its last frame.

text.description: What the part shows, in the user's own words.

description.description: The effect in the user's own words, in place of preset.

element.description: Optional element or colour that every part is drawn in.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key (letters, numbers, - and _). Reusing it returns the same request without a new charge; a new key makes a new take with the same settings.

parts.description: The parts to draw, by key, each one at most once. With a preset, its own parts (explosion: SPARK, BLAST, SMOKE; aura: RISES, PULSES, FADES; fireball: FORMING, FLYING, BURST; lightning: GATHERS, STRIKE, SCORCH; frostnova: GATHERS, BURST, LINGERS; slash: CHARGE, SLASH, SMALL_HIT; necrotic: GATHERS, BURST, LINGERS; heal: BURST, RISES, FADES; poison: SPLASH, CLOUD, DRIPS; arcaneorb: ORB, FLYING, BURSTS; shield: RISES, HOLDS, BREAKS; portal: OPENS, SWIRLS, CLOSES). With a description: BUILDS_UP, MAIN, FADES. parts and custom_parts together hold 1 to 10 parts.

preset.description: One of CharGen's effects. Give preset or description, not both.

quote_token.description: Approved quote_token from chargen_quote_sprite_effect. Use the same inputs; changed inputs or prices fail without charging.

reference_set_id.description: Optional set_id of one of the user's character sprite sets (chargen_get_job shows set_id). The effect is drawn in the colours of that character's Cast move, or of its base sprite.

title.description: Optional name for these sprites in the user's library.

name: chargen_generate_sprite_effect
title: Order sprite effect
